description: R08 Host ScreenBuffer delayed-wrap checkpoint: safe Rust owns the portable Last Column Flag reset matrix and multiline autowrap continuation beyond the visible viewport.

entries.notes: AutowrapState owns pending Last Column Flag cancellation and cursor effects across all 36 Microsoft data rows: DEC margins/rendition/modes, cursor movement, BS/LF/VT/FF/CR/IND/RI/NEL, character/line editing, and display/line erase controls. HT and SUB remain intentionally outside the reset set exactly as Microsoft documents.

The same owner writes width-sized logical segments through delayed wrap, extends rows below the initial viewport bottom, and reproduces Microsoft's four-line 1/2/3/4 continuation with the cursor three rows below its starting row.
